subject: math
title: The Calendar: Days of the Week, Months, Seasons and Holidays
seo_title: Grade 1 Calendar Math Worksheets: Days, Weeks, Months and Seasons, Free with Answer Key (Ontario)
standard_text: Read the date on a calendar, and use a calendar to identify days, weeks, months, holidays, and seasons
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 math worksheets on the calendar for the Ontario curriculum: days of the week, yesterday and tomorrow, months and seasons in Canada, reading the date on a calendar, counting days and weeks, and Canada Day, Thanksgiving and Family Day. 100 picture questions with an answer key.
key_big: A week has 7 days. A year has 12 months. Each row of a calendar is 1 week.
key_sub: After Saturday comes Sunday. To count days, count the jumps and do not count today. In Canada, winter is December to February.
body_html:
Days of the week

A week has 7 days. Say them in order every day.

After Saturday comes Sunday. Then the days go round again.

Tomorrow

Today is Saturday. What day is tomorrow?

The day after Saturday is Sunday.

Answer: Sunday

Months and seasons

A year has 12 months. It starts with January and ends with December.

Read a calendar

Each row is 1 week. Find the date. Then go up to the top to see the day.

Count the days

How many days from July 1 to July 9?

Count the jumps: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. That is 8 jumps. Do not count July 1.

Answer: 8 days

Holidays in Ontario

HolidayWhenSeason
New Year’s DayJanuary 1winter
Family Daya Monday in Februarywinter
Canada DayJuly 1summer
Thanksgivinga Monday in Octoberfall
Christmas DayDecember 25winter

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
After Saturday comes MondayAfter Saturday comes Sunday
Counting today: June 9 to June 12 is 4 daysCount the jumps: 10, 11, 12. That is 3 days
Mixing up yesterday and tomorrowYesterday is the day before. Tomorrow is the day after
Every month starts on SundayLook at the calendar: June 1, 2027 is a Tuesday
January is summerIn Canada, January is winter

faq.q: What do Grade 1 students learn about the calendar in Ontario?
faq.a: In the Ontario Mathematics Curriculum (2020), Grade 1 students read the date on a calendar and use it to find days, weeks, months, holidays and seasons.

faq.q: What are the seasons in Canada by month?
faq.a: Winter is December, January and February; spring is March, April and May; summer is June, July and August; fall is September, October and November.

faq.q: When are Canada Day, Thanksgiving and Family Day?
faq.a: Canada Day is always July 1. Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October, and Family Day in Ontario is the third Monday in February.

faq.q: How can I help my child learn the days and months at home?
faq.a: Hang a calendar at your child’s height. Each morning, say the date together, cross off yesterday and count the sleeps to the next birthday or holiday.

sets.title: Days of the week: yesterday, today and tomorrow

items.q: Which day comes after Monday?
items.e: Say the days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. Tuesday comes after Monday. (Sunday comes before.)

items.q: Which day comes before Friday?
items.e: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday. Thursday is just before Friday. (Saturday comes after.)

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. Wednesday is between them.

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Saturday is between them.

items.q: Which day comes after Saturday?
items.e: After Saturday comes Sunday. Then a new week goes on: Monday, Tuesday … (Monday comes after Sunday.)

items.q: Which day comes before Sunday?
items.e: Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Saturday is just before Sunday. (Monday comes after.)

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. Wednesday is missing.

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. Friday is missing.

items.q: Which two days are the weekend?
items.e: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday. They are red on the calendar. There is no school.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day is tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is the next day. The day after Thursday is Friday. (Wednesday was yesterday.)

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day was yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before. The day before Tuesday is Monday. (Wednesday is tomorrow.)

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day is tomorrow?
items.e: The day after Saturday is Sunday. (A new week does not start with Monday on this calendar.)

items.q: Today is Monday. What day was yesterday?
items.e: The day before Monday is Sunday. (Tuesday is tomorrow.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day was yesterday?
items.e: The day before Wednesday is Tuesday. (Thursday is tomorrow.)

items.q: Tomorrow is Friday. What day is today?
items.e: Today is the day before tomorrow. The day before Friday is Thursday.

items.q: Yesterday was Sunday. What day is today?
items.e: Today is the day after yesterday. The day after Sunday is Monday.

items.q: Which list of days is in order?
items.e: The days go Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday … The other lists mix them up.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day is the day after tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is Thursday. The day after that is Friday. (Thursday is only tomorrow.)

items.q: Today is Friday. What day was it 2 days ago?
items.e: Count back 2 days. Do not count today. Thursday (1), Wednesday (2). It was Wednesday. (Thursday counts today as day 1. Sunday counts on, not back.)

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days. Do not count today. Sunday (1), Monday (2). It will be Monday. (Sunday counts today as day 1.)

sets.title: Months of the year and seasons in Canada

items.q: How many months are in a year?
items.e: Count the boxes: January to December. There are 12 months. (7 is the days in a week. 4 is the seasons.)

items.q: Which month is first in the year?
items.e: The year starts with January. December is the last month.

items.q: Which month comes after March?
items.e: January, February, March, April. April comes after March. (February comes before it.)

items.q: Which month comes before October?
items.e: August, September, October. September is just before October.

items.q: Which month comes after December?
items.e: December is the last month. Then a new year starts with January.

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: Jun, Jul, Aug. The missing month is July.

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: Oct, Nov, Dec. The missing month is November.

items.q: How many seasons are in a year?
items.e: Winter, spring, summer and fall: 4 seasons. (12 is the number of months.)

items.q: Which season is missing?
items.e: The seasons go winter, spring, summer, fall. September, October and November are fall.

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: Winter is Dec, Jan, Feb. The missing month is January. (July is in summer.)

items.q: In Canada, which season is January?
items.e: December, January and February are winter. It is cold and snowy. So January is in winter.

items.q: In Canada, which season is July?
items.e: June, July and August are summer. It is hot. There is no school. So July is in summer.

items.q: In Canada, which season is October?
items.e: September, October and November are fall. The leaves change colour. So October is in fall.

items.q: In Canada, which season is April?
items.e: March, April and May are spring. The snow melts. So April is in spring.

items.q: Which months are winter in Canada?
items.e: It is cold and snowy in December, January and February. That is winter.

items.q: Which months are summer in Canada?
items.e: It is hot in June, July and August. That is summer.

items.q: Which season comes after winter?
items.e: The seasons go winter, spring, summer, fall. Then winter again. (Fall comes before winter.)

items.q: Hana’s birthday is in August. Which season is that?
items.e: June, July and August are summer. So her birthday is in summer.

items.q: It is winter. Which month could it be?
items.e: Winter is December, January and February. (July is summer. May is spring. September is fall.)

items.q: The leaves fall off the trees. Which month could it be?
items.e: Leaves fall in fall: September, October and November.

sets.title: Read the date on a calendar

items.q: Which month does this calendar show?
items.e: The month is at the top: June 2027. (Sunday is a day, not a month.)

items.q: What day is June 1?
items.e: Find 1. Go up to the top of its column: Tue. June 1 is a Tuesday. (A month does not always start on Sunday.)

items.q: What day is June 10?
items.e: Find 10. Go up to the top of its column: Thursday.

items.q: What day is June 19?
items.e: Find 19. Go up to the top of its column: Saturday.

items.q: What day is June 27?
items.e: Find 27. Go up to the top of its column: Sunday.

items.q: What is the date of the first Friday in June?
items.e: Go down the Fri column. The first number is 4. It is June 4. (June 1 is the first date, but it is a Tuesday.)

items.q: Which date is a Monday?
items.e: Look in the Mon column: 7, 14, 21, 28. So June 14 is a Monday. (June 13 is a Sunday.)

items.q: How many Sundays are in June?
items.e: The Sundays are 6, 13, 20, 27. That is 4 Sundays. (27 is the date of the last one.)

items.q: What date comes just after June 15?
items.e: The next date is one more: 15 + 1 = 16. (June 22 is the date under it, one week later.)

items.q: What date comes just before June 13?
items.e: The date before is one less: 13 − 1 = 12. It is at the end of the row above. (June 6 is the date above 13, one week before.)

items.q: What is the last day of June?
items.e: The last number on the calendar is 30. So it is June 30. (June has 30 days. There is no June 31.)

items.q: What day is the last day of June?
items.e: The last date is 30. Go up its column: Wednesday. (Saturday is the end of the row, not the last day.)

items.q: The Terry Fox Run is circled. What is the date?
items.e: The red circle is around 24. The run is on September 24.

items.q: What day is the Terry Fox Run?
items.e: Go up from the circled 24 to the top: Friday.

items.q: The first day of school is in the green box. What is the date?
items.e: The green box is around 7. School starts on September 7.

items.q: What day is the first day of school?
items.e: Go up from 7 to the top: Tuesday. (Monday, September 6 is Labour Day.)

items.q: Mei’s birthday is September 15. What day is that?
items.e: Find 15. Go up to the top of its column: Wednesday.

items.q: Which date is a Saturday?
items.e: Look in the Sat column: 4, 11, 18, 25. So September 18 is a Saturday. (September 19 is a Sunday.)

items.q: How many Fridays are in September?
items.e: The Fridays are 3, 10, 17, 24. That is 4 Fridays.

items.q: September 30 is the last day. What day will October 1 be?
items.e: September 30 is a Thursday. October 1 is the next day: Friday. (A new month does not always start on Sunday.)

sets.title: Count the days: weeks and days on a calendar

items.q: How many days are in 1 week?
items.e: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. That is 7 days. (5 is only the school days.)

items.q: How many school days are in 1 week?
items.e: Monday to Friday are school days. That is 5 days. (7 counts the weekend too.)

items.q: How many days are in the weekend?
items.e: Saturday and Sunday. That is 2 days.

items.q: How many days are in 2 weeks?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 7 + 7 = 14 days. (7 is only 1 week.)

items.q: Noah’s cousin stays for 1 week and 2 days. How many days is that?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 7 + 2 = 9 days. (3 adds 1 + 2. It forgets that a week is 7 days.)

items.q: Today is June 9. How many days until Ava’s party?
items.e: Count the jumps from 9 to 12: 10, 11, 12. That is 3. Do not count today. (4 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 14. How many days until the field trip?
items.e: Count the jumps from 14 to 18: 15, 16, 17, 18. That is 4. Do not count today. (5 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 2. How many days until the class picnic?
items.e: Count the jumps from 2 to 9: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. That is 7. Do not count today. 9 is right under 2. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 21. How many days until the soccer game?
items.e: Count the jumps from 21 to 26: 22, 23, 24, 25, 26. That is 5. Do not count today. (6 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 15. What is the date 1 week from today?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 15 + 7 = 22. Go straight down one row: June 22. (June 21 counts today as day 1. June 8 is 1 week ago.)

items.q: Today is June 8. What is the date 3 days from today?
items.e: Count on 3: 9, 10, 11. It is June 11. (June 10 counts today as day 1. June 5 counts back.)

items.q: How many weeks from the first swim class to the swimming test?
items.e: 21 is 2 rows straight under 7. Each row down is 1 week. That is 2 weeks. (3 weeks counts the rows, not the jumps.)

items.q: How many days are in June?
items.e: The last date is 30. June has 30 days. (7 is the days in one row. 5 is the rows.)

items.q: Arjun crosses off each day that is done. Today is November 10. How many days are crossed off?
items.e: The Xs are on 1 to 9. That is 9 days. (10 counts today too, but today is not done yet.)

items.q: How many Mondays are in November?
items.e: The Mondays are 1, 8, 15, 22, 29. That is 5 Mondays. (29 is the date of the last one.)

items.q: Today is November 4. How many days until Remembrance Day?
items.e: Count the jumps from 4 to 11: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11. That is 7. Do not count today. 11 is right under 4. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)

items.q: Liam swims every Tuesday. How many times does he swim in 2 weeks?
items.e: There is 1 Tuesday in each week. 1 + 1 = 2 times. (14 is the days in 2 weeks.)

items.q: Today is Friday. The field trip is on Monday. How many days until the field trip?
items.e: Count on from Friday: Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3). That is 3 days. (4 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is Sunday. Ethan has hockey on Saturday. How many days until hockey?
items.e: Count on: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. That is 6 days. (7 counts today too.)

items.q: School started on September 7. Today is September 14. How many days ago did school start?
items.e: Count the jumps from 7 to 14: 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. That is 7. Do not count today. 14 is right under 7. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)

sets.title: Holidays on the calendar: Canada Day, Thanksgiving, Family Day

items.q: Canada Day is circled. What is the date?
items.e: The red circle is around 1 in July. Canada Day is July 1. It is Canada’s birthday.

items.q: What day is Canada Day in 2027?
items.e: Go up from the circled 1 to the top: Thursday. (July does not start on Sunday.)

items.q: Canada Day is in July. Which season is that?
items.e: June, July and August are summer. Canada Day is in summer. There is no school.

items.q: Today is June 28. How many sleeps until Canada Day?
items.e: Count the jumps: June 29 (1), June 30 (2), July 1 (3). That is 3 sleeps. (4 counts today too.)

items.q: Thanksgiving is circled. What is the date?
items.e: The red circle is around 11. Thanksgiving is on October 11 in 2027.

items.q: What day is Thanksgiving?
items.e: Go up from 11 to the top: Monday. In Canada, Thanksgiving is always on a Monday in October.

items.q: In Canada, which month is Thanksgiving in?
items.e: Canada has Thanksgiving in October. (The USA has it in November.)

items.q: Thanksgiving is in October. Which season is that?
items.e: September, October and November are fall. Thanksgiving is in fall.

items.q: Today is October 4. How many days until Thanksgiving?
items.e: Count the jumps from 4 to 11: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11. That is 7. Do not count today. 11 is right under 4. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)

items.q: Halloween is October 31. What day is it in 2027?
items.e: 31 is in the first column: Sunday. (Saturday is the last column.)

items.q: Family Day is circled. What is the date?
items.e: The red circle is around 15. Family Day is on February 15 in 2027. (February 14 is Valentine’s Day.)

items.q: What day is Family Day?
items.e: Go up from 15 to the top: Monday. Family Day is always on a Monday in February.

items.q: Family Day is in February. Which season is that?
items.e: December, January and February are winter. Family Day is in winter. Many families go skating.

items.q: Today is February 10. How many days until Family Day?
items.e: Count the jumps from 10 to 15: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15. That is 5. Do not count today. (6 counts today too.)

items.q: There is no school on Family Day. How many school days are in that week?
items.e: School days are Monday to Friday, but Monday is a holiday. Tuesday to Friday is 4 days. (5 forgets the holiday.)

items.q: Today is December 20. How many sleeps until Christmas Day?
items.e: Count the jumps from 20 to 25: 21, 22, 23, 24, 25. That is 5. Do not count today. (6 counts today too.)

items.q: Which holiday is in summer?
items.e: Canada Day is July 1. July is summer. (Thanksgiving is in fall. Family Day and Christmas are in winter.)

items.q: New Year’s Day is the first day of the year. What is the date?
items.e: The year starts with January. The first day is January 1. (December 31 is the last day.)

items.q: Maya’s class makes poppies on November 4. Remembrance Day is 1 week later. What is the date?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 4 + 7 = 11. Go straight down one row: November 11. (November 10 counts November 4 as day 1.)

items.q: Canada Day is July 1. Leah’s birthday is July 9. How many days after Canada Day is it?
items.e: Count the jumps from 1 to 9: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. That is 8. Do not count July 1. (9 counts July 1 too.)
